strict_R_coverage_and_intersection.definition: Token mask R = exact repetition union noisy strict0.75, with the frozen EOS/whitespace/unstable-byte exclusions. This is distinct from response-level normalized-text cycle128.
strict_R_coverage_and_intersection.anchor_definition: s0 = logp(round start) - logq(saved rollout); negative anchor anomaly is A<0 ands0<-0.5. A sign is not a correctness label.
strict_R_coverage_and_intersection.current_d_scope: d = abs(logp(current update)-logq(saved rollout)); all valid positions including masked tokens, not active-loss-only.

limitations: Exactly completed601..650 data; no618 prefix is substituted.
One online trajectory, not multi-seed evidence or a causal ranking.
Token-level strictR and response-level cycle128 candidates are different definitions.
Advantage sign is not correctness. Currentd statistics include masked tokens.
This package does not change canonical four-arm/secondary coverage; primary64x8 is a separate population.

mapping.description: Frozen original_global128_groups;8contiguous64-row ranks, B2 selects local16..31 from each rank

maximum_norm_update_evidence.scope: Existing recorded mechanical candidate flags, not semantic verdicts; labels can overlap. A sign is not correctness. No new model/detector/backward calls, no raw text/token IDs or saved-row IDs published. R outside is not a normality label; no counterfactual gradient is measured.
